The FCC ID printed on the label is S9ZTEW624UB, which is incorrect. S9ZTEW624UB is the FCC ID for the previous ('''Marvell''' based) revision. "21516DW140C11A1" and "DWA-140C1 Rev.A1" is silkscreened on the board. :This device would seem to be a [[Cameo WLN-1502]], which appears to be the same OEM product as the [[D-Link DWA-140 rev C1]]. The FCC ID of the WLN-1502 has been assigned to this entry.
